executiveSummary: Iranian-affiliated actors are actively manipulating PLC logic and HMI/SCADA data across U.S. critical infrastructure, creating immediate safety and operational risk. Security Advisory Credentials for tens of thousands of Fortinet FortiGate appliances (“FortiBleed”) are circulating, enabling VPN access and AD credential theft; immediate credential rotation and segmentation are required. View Article Check Point and Palo Alto Networks VPN authentication bypass pathways (active in specific configurations) enable unauthorized remote access that may bridge into OT networks—rapid patching and protocol hardening are urgent. JPCERT Alert JPCERT Advisory Multiple nation-state campaigns are ongoing: Mirage Kitten deploying new backdoors/tunnelers and OilRig-linked CAV3RN abusing Microsoft Graph/Outlook for stealth C2, heightening identity and proxy-abuse risks around enterprise-OT pivots. Supporting Report Supporting Report Edge device exploitation remains elevated: actively exploited F5 BIG‑IP APM and multiple KEV additions (Fortinet, SonicWall, Microsoft SharePoint/AD FS, Arista VeloCloud) require accelerated remediation and compromise assessments. CERT-FR Alert CISA KEV OT/ICS advisories include Siemens Desigo CC (OpenSSL CMS AEAD overflow) and multiple Siemens/ICS simulation and PLC products—patch planning and network isolation are necessary to reduce operational disruption risk. ICS Advisory

topThreats.action: 1) PLC Logic Manipulation Campaign Immediate risk to safety and operations across Water/WWS and Energy through direct controller tampering. Prioritize disconnection from internet, lock controllers to Run, audit logic and AOIs. CRITICAL Security Advisory

2) FortiGate “FortiBleed” Credential Exposure Large-scale Fortinet credential leakage enables VPN entry and AD credential interception; rotate all secrets, enforce MFA, restrict management plane. HIGH View Article

3) Zimbra Zero‑Day Email Exfiltration (LAUNDRY BEAR) Webmail exploitation exfiltrates emails, tokens, scratch codes; revoke app passwords, patch to 10.1.13/10.0.18, hunt DNS exfil paths. CRITICAL Security Advisory
4) PAN‑OS GlobalProtect Auth Bypass CAS-enabled GlobalProtect portals/gateways may allow unauthenticated access; patch, disable CAS auth paths, restrict exposure. HIGH View Article

descriptions: Initial access via VPN/edge device auth bypass: External Remote Services (T1133), Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190)
Identity abuse and stealth C2: Valid Accounts (T1078), Cloud Services (T1583/TA0001), C2 over Email/Graph APIs
Living-off-the-land: PowerShell, WMI, RDP, Scheduled Tasks (T1053), Web Shells (T1505.003)
OT/ICS-specific: Modify Control Logic, Disable/Modify Alarms, Unsecured direct PLC access
Network tunneling: WebSocket/WSS SOCKS relays to evade proxies; DNS AAAA for config recovery
